metadata.title: hyperCAD-S Healing Operations - Complete Enumeration
metadata.description: Exhaustive parameter catalog for hyperCAD-S Healing & Repair workspace. Healing is hyperCAD's signature feature — designed for the reality that hyperMILL operators routinely receive STEP / IGES / Parasolid imports from upstream CAD with gaps, slivers, non-manifold edges, and self-intersections that block toolpath kernels. Catalog covers: 3 auto/diagnostic ops (Auto-Heal / Gap-Detector / Validate-Watertight), 8 manual repair ops (Manual-Gap-Fill / Knit-Faces / Force-Stitch / Remove-Feature / Remove-Fillet / Replace-Face / Edge-Blend / Repair-Self-Intersect), and 5 edge / curve cleanup ops (Decimate-Edge / Smooth-Curve / Fix-Tangent / Snap-To-Grid / Detect-Non-Manifold). Auto-Heal is the canonical first pass on imported geometry; the manual ops handle anything Auto-Heal couldn't resolve.
metadata.source: OPEN MIND hyperCAD-S Healing Reference, OPEN MIND hyperCAD-S User Manual

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across hyperCAD-S healing operations

AUTO_HEAL.description: Automatic geometry healing pass. Applies a pipeline of gap-stitch, knit, fix-tangent, decimate, and watertight-validate stages on imported bodies. First-pass tool for any STEP / IGES / Parasolid import.

parameters.name: Target Bodies
parameters.description: Bodies to heal (solids, sheets, mixed)

parameters.name: Gap Tolerance
parameters.description: Maximum gap that gets stitched (overrides aggressiveness preset)

parameters.name: Tangent Tolerance
parameters.description: Maximum angle defect treated as tangent-fixable

parameters.name: Stages
parameters.description: Pipeline stages to run

parameters.name: Stop On First Failure
parameters.description: Halt pipeline if any stage cannot complete (vs continue with warnings)

parameters.name: Preserve Original
parameters.description: Keep original body alongside healed copy

GAP_DETECTOR.description: Diagnostic — locate edge gaps in target body without modifying geometry. Returns edge-pair list + gap distances. Read-only feeder for MANUAL_GAP_FILL.

parameters.name: Min Gap
parameters.description: Smallest gap to report

parameters.name: Max Gap
parameters.description: Largest gap to report (above this counts as missing-face, not gap)

parameters.name: Highlight In Viewport
parameters.description: Color-code gap edges by severity in active viewport

VALIDATE_WATERTIGHT.description: Diagnostic — verify a body / shell is watertight (closed manifold). Returns pass / fail plus list of open edges. Required gate before SURFACE_TO_SOLID and before hyperMILL volume-toolpath generation.

parameters.name: Edge Tolerance
parameters.description: Edges closer than this are treated as joined

parameters.name: Require Outward Orientation
parameters.description: Also verify face normals all point outward (consistent shell orientation)

MANUAL_GAP_FILL.description: Manually close a single gap between two edges with a stitched face strip. Optional G1 / G2 continuity to adjacent surfaces.

parameters.name: Uniform Width
parameters.description: Fixed strip width (Strip Width Mode = uniform)

KNIT_FACES.description: Knit (sew) selected faces / surfaces into a unified shell along shared edges. More targeted than Auto-Heal stitch — operator chooses which faces to combine.

parameters.name: Adjust Surfaces If Needed
parameters.description: Allow small surface re-fit to close marginal gaps during knit

parameters.name: Preserve Source Faces
parameters.description: Keep source faces alongside knit result

FORCE_STITCH.description: Aggressive stitch — close gaps even when above standard tolerance by inserting a blend strip. Last-resort tool when AUTO_HEAL aggressive mode cannot close watertight.

parameters.name: Gap Edges
parameters.description: Specific gap-edge pairs to force-close (empty = all detected gaps)

parameters.name: Max Forced Gap
parameters.description: Upper bound on gap size that will be force-closed (safety guard)

parameters.name: Mark Forced Edges
parameters.description: Tag forced-close edges for downstream review

REMOVE_FEATURE.description: Remove a feature (hole, fillet, chamfer, pocket) from a body and re-extend adjacent faces to close the void. History-free operation suitable for imported solids.

parameters.name: Feature Faces
parameters.description: Faces composing the feature to remove

parameters.name: Maintain Adjacent Tangency
parameters.description: Preserve tangent continuity on faces that bordered the removed feature

REMOVE_FILLET.description: Specialized REMOVE_FEATURE for fillet faces. Detects fillet face-set automatically by curvature continuity and removes the rolling-ball blend, restoring sharp edges.

parameters.name: Fillet Edge Or Face
parameters.description: Any edge or face on the fillet — auto-detects rest of fillet face-set

parameters.name: Auto Extend Faces
parameters.description: Auto-extend adjacent flat faces to recover sharp edge

parameters.name: Detection Tolerance
parameters.description: Curvature variation within face-set treated as fillet

parameters.name: Fail If Variable Radius
parameters.description: Refuse removal if fillet has variable radius (safety guard)

HEAL_REPLACE_FACE.description: Replace one or more healing-target faces with a clean replacement surface. Healing-domain alias for SURFACE_REPLACE — narrows the workflow to repair contexts and emits healing audit metadata.

parameters.name: Extend If Short
parameters.description: Auto-extend replacement to fully cover target faces

parameters.name: Tag As Repair
parameters.description: Emit healing-audit metadata (face was a repair, not original geometry)

EDGE_BLEND.description: Insert a small smooth blend across a sharp tangent break between adjacent faces. Healing-domain analog of fillet, optimized for fairing imperfect imports rather than design-time edge breaks.

parameters.name: Blend Width
parameters.description: Effective fillet radius along edges

parameters.name: Detect Sharp Only
parameters.description: Skip edges already with tangent continuity better than threshold

parameters.name: Sharpness Threshold
parameters.description: Min angle defect that qualifies an edge for blending

REPAIR_SELF_INTERSECT.description: Detect and resolve self-intersecting faces / surfaces. Strategy: trim crossing region, re-fit cleaner surface, or remove offending face entirely. Critical for offset / shell results that overlap themselves.

parameters.name: Detection Tolerance
parameters.description: Minimum overlap distance to flag as self-intersection

parameters.name: Preserve Volume
parameters.description: Bias repair toward preserving enclosed volume vs preserving area

parameters.name: Max Repair Iterations
parameters.description: Cap on repair passes (safety guard against pathological inputs)

DECIMATE_EDGE.description: Reduce control-point density on edge / curve geometry without exceeding tolerance. Used to clean over-sampled imports (typical of converted scan data).

parameters.name: Maximum Deviation
parameters.description: Max distance decimated curve may deviate from original

parameters.name: Preserve Tangents At Joins
parameters.description: Hold tangent continuity at endpoints when joining adjacent edges

SMOOTH_CURVE.description: Smooth high-frequency oscillation in target curves while staying within tolerance. Used after scan-to-curve fits to remove digitizer noise.

parameters.name: Smoothing Weight
parameters.description: 0 = preserve shape exactly, 1 = maximum smoothing

parameters.name: Maximum Deviation
parameters.description: Hard upper bound on curve displacement

parameters.name: Preserve Inflection Points
parameters.description: Lock points of curvature reversal during smoothing

FIX_TANGENT.description: Adjust adjacent edge / face pairs to recover tangent continuity that was lost in import (typical of mismatched STEP curve degrees).

parameters.name: Tangent Tolerance
parameters.description: Maximum angle defect treated as fixable (above this needs blend / fillet, not tangent fix)

parameters.name: Maximum Deviation
parameters.description: Hard upper bound on geometry displacement during fix

parameters.name: Lock One Side
parameters.description: Adjust only the second edge of each pair (vs symmetric adjustment)

SNAP_TO_GRID.description: Snap point coordinates to a regular grid. Used to clean drift in vertex coordinates introduced by upstream floating-point round-trips.

parameters.name: Target Points
parameters.description: Vertices / control points (empty = all vertices in target body)

parameters.name: Target Body
parameters.description: Body whose vertices should snap (alternative to Target Points)

parameters.name: Grid Spacing
parameters.description: Snap-grid resolution

parameters.name: Maximum Snap Distance
parameters.description: Cap on per-point displacement (safety guard)

parameters.name: Grid Origin
parameters.description: Origin of snap grid (defaults to world origin)

parameters.name: Re-Fit Affected Curves
parameters.description: Re-fit curves whose endpoints moved to maintain edge continuity

DETECT_NON_MANIFOLD.description: Diagnostic — locate non-manifold edges (edges shared by 3+ faces or otherwise topologically invalid). Read-only feeder for downstream repair operations.

platform_notes.auto_first: Recommended workflow: AUTO_HEAL first, GAP_DETECTOR + DETECT_NON_MANIFOLD on what remains, then targeted manual ops.
platform_notes.watertight_gate: VALIDATE_WATERTIGHT is required before any volume-toolpath generation in hyperMILL. Auto-Heal with the validate_watertight stage emits this gate as part of the pipeline.
platform_notes.history_free: All healing operations are history-free — they bypass the parametric history tree because healing inputs are typically imported solids without history.
